$comment: Describes content/portfolio.json for the portfolio admin app. Field order is the order fields are stored and shown.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Search description
fields.hint: Shown by search engines under the title. Aim for 150–160 characters.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Full name
fields.hint: "Hello, i'm …", the hero code window and the footer.

fields.name: shortName
fields.label: Short name
fields.hint: Logo text and the first word of the Home headline.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Job title
fields.hint: Shown in the footer.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location / address
fields.hint: The "Find me here" box on Contacts. This is public.

fields.name: profileImage
fields.label: Home photo
fields.hint: Leave empty to show only the code window.

fields.name: aboutImage
fields.label: About page photo
fields.hint: Leave empty to reuse the Home photo.

fields.name: resumeAuto
fields.label: Generate CV automatically from this portfolio
fields.hint: On: every save rebuilds the CV (PDF and Word) from your profile, skills, experience, education and projects. Off: visitors download the files uploaded below.

fields.name: resumeUrl
fields.label: CV / resume file
fields.hint: Used when automatic CV is off. PDF or Word.

fields.name: resumeAltUrl
fields.label: CV in another format
fields.hint: Optional, used when automatic CV is off: the same CV in the other format. Visitors then choose which to download.

fields.name: yearsOfExperience
fields.label: Years of experience
fields.hint: Hero code window and the big number on Home.

fields.name: currentProject
fields.label: Currently working on
fields.hint: The status bar under the hero. Leave empty to hide it.

fields.name: shortBio
fields.label: Short bio
fields.hint: The grey line under the Home headline.

fields.name: about
fields.label: About paragraphs
fields.hint: One paragraph per line. The About page shows all of them; Home shows the first two.

fields.name: techStack
fields.label: Hero code window stack
fields.hint: One per line. Shown in the Developer.cs window.

fields.name: footerTagline
fields.label: Footer tagline
fields.hint: Shown after the job title in the footer, e.g. "ASP.NET Core · Angular · React".

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: Starts with your short name. Words in [square brackets] are shown in purple.

fields.name: quote.text
fields.label: Quote
fields.hint: Joins the daily rotation with the quotes on the Quotes page.

fields.name: contactIntro
fields.label: Contact intro
fields.hint: Next to the contact box on Home and on Contacts.

skillCategories.label: Skill categories
skillCategories.description: Each category is one box of skills. Order them to choose which box comes first.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Skill name
fields.hint: The icon is picked from the name unless you choose one below.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Level
fields.hint: Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

experience.label: Experience
experience.description: Shown on Works (#work-experience) and the About timeline. The first entry is at the top.

fields.name: client
fields.label: Client
fields.hint: Optional. Shown as "Client: …".

fields.name: position
fields.label: Position
fields.hint: Shown under the company when set.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.hint: Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM, e.g. 2025-01. Year only (YYYY) also works.

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End date
fields.hint: Leave empty for your current job.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

fields.name: technologies
fields.label: Technologies
fields.hint: One per line. Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

fields.name: field
fields.label: Field of study
fields.hint: Shown as "B.Sc in …" when set.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM, e.g. 2025-01. Year only (YYYY) also works.

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End date
fields.hint: The year is shown on the site.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

projects.label: Projects
projects.idHint: Used in links like /works#cm-core. Changing it breaks links that use the old ID.
projects.description: Featured projects appear in the Home #projects section (first three by order). All visible projects appear on Works.

fields.name: tagline
fields.label: Tagline
fields.hint: One-line summary under the title.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Shown when "Details" is opened on Works.

fields.name: responsibilities
fields.label: Responsibilities
fields.hint: One per line.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM, e.g. 2025-01. Year only (YYYY) also works.

fields.name: endDate
fields.label: End date
fields.hint: Leave empty if ongoing.

fields.name: technologies
fields.label: Technologies
fields.hint: One per line.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Cover image
fields.hint: Optional. Replaces the coloured cover with a picture.

fields.name: liveUrl
fields.label: Live URL
fields.hint: Optional. Adds a "Live" button.

fields.name: githubUrl
fields.label: GitHub URL
fields.hint: Optional. Adds a "Github" button.

certifications.label: Certifications
certifications.description: Shown on the About page in a #certifications section once you add one.

fields.name: issueDate
fields.label: Issue date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM, e.g. 2025-01. Year only (YYYY) also works.

fields.name: credentialUrl
fields.label: Credential URL
fields.hint: Optional. Makes the name a link.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.hint: Saved with your content, but not displayed by the current site design.

achievements.label: Achievements
achievements.description: Shown on the About page in an #achievements section once you add one.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM, e.g. 2025-01. Year only (YYYY) also works.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.hint: Optional. Makes the title a link.

quickFacts.label: Quick facts
quickFacts.description: The small boxes at the bottom of the About page.

fields.name: highlights
fields.label: Highlighted words
fields.hint: One per line. Copy each exactly from the fact text, including capitals.

quotes.label: Quotes
quotes.description: The Home page quote changes every day, cycling through these in order (plus the quote on Home & SEO). Visitors can also press ↻ for a random one. Hide or archive a quote to take it out of the rotation.

roles.label: Roles
roles.idHint: The role's web address: /r/<id> on this site, /p/<name>/<id> on a profile. Don't use works, about-me or contacts.
roles.description: Job-based versions of the portfolio, each at its own address. A role replaces the title, headline, bio and CV, and shows only the skills, projects and experience you pick (nothing picked shows everything).

fields.name: name
fields.label: Role name
fields.hint: For you; also the default job title.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Job title
fields.hint: Replaces the profile's job title. Empty uses the role name.

fields.name: headline
fields.label: Home headline
fields.hint: Replaces the Home headline. Words in [square brackets] are shown in purple.

fields.name: shortBio
fields.label: Short bio
fields.hint: Replaces the grey line under the Home headline.

fields.name: about
fields.label: About paragraphs
fields.hint: One paragraph per line. Empty keeps the profile's About text.

fields.name: techStack
fields.label: Hero code window stack
fields.hint: One per line. Empty keeps the profile's stack.

fields.name: resumeUrl
fields.label: CV / resume file for this role
fields.hint: Optional: upload a CV for this role. Empty uses the automatic CV for this role (or the profile's uploaded CV when automatic CV is off).

fields.name: resumeAltUrl
fields.label: This role's CV in another format
fields.hint: Optional second format for this role's CV.

fields.name: projects
fields.label: Projects to show
fields.hint: Shown in this order on Works; the first three are featured on Home.

pages.label: Profile
pages.description: Your name, contact details, photos and CV.

pages.label: About
pages.description: The introduction on the About page and the quick facts at the bottom.

pages.label: Home & SEO
pages.description: Home page text, page subtitles and what search engines show.

sections.description: Written into the portfolio's HTML when it rebuilds, so search engines see it without running JavaScript.

pages.label: Quotes
pages.description: The Home quote of the day: one a day, in this order.

pages.label: Skills
pages.description: Skills are grouped into categories. Both appear on Home and About.

pages.label: Social Links
pages.description: Shown with your email and phone in the side rail, footer, menu and Contacts page. Empty links are hidden.

pages.label: Roles
pages.description: Tailor the portfolio for each kind of job, with one address per role to send with applications.
